## Actual candidate process run

The real-process suite executed all 44 independently defined meaning rows against the reconstructed frozen candidate. The result is **26 PASS, 18 RED**; the complete row-by-row table is `RESULT-MATRIX.tsv`, with raw suite, process, and fixture custody in `runs/real-process-v2-attempt-07/` and `fixtures/real-process-v2-attempt-07/`.

The 18 candidate-specific RED rows are:

- Durable identity receipt missing: `live-create`, `archive-create`, `live-open-reuse`, `archive-open-reuse`, `open-probe-failure`, `merged-open-not-republished`, `merged-closed-violation`, and `merged-probe-unknown`. In create/reuse cases the actual child exited successfully and created or reused the request, but its durable request record contains only project, branch, PR URL/number, timestamp, keep-open mode, request outcome, and mainline status. It has no identity object carrying the claim digest, repository, member set, source head, ledger hash, and evidence manifest required by these assertions. The open-probe case reports `unknown` as expected but remains RED for the missing identity receipt. The three MERGED cases do not republish a PR; their identity receipt is still absent.
- Unsafe acceptance before publication refusal: `conflicting-action`, `missing-repository`, `malformed-repository`, `repository-mismatch`, `missing-digest`, `malformed-digest`, `digest-mismatch`, `missing-member`, `malformed-member`, and `unsupported-forge`. Each actual process succeeded and the spy observed request creation, local Git push, durable request recording, and archive effects. These are candidate-source failures against independently asserted refusal/effect requirements, not assertions over modeled result objects.

The remaining 26 rows pass: `legacy-default-close`, `legacy-keep-open-refusal`, `missing-action`, `malformed-action`, `member-mismatch`, `unsupported-bundle`, `mixed-disposition`, `missing-branch`, `malformed-branch`, `branch-mismatch`, `closing-commit-reference-create`, `qualified-closing-commit-reference-reuse`, `wrong-base-existing-pr`, `wrong-head-existing-pr`, `closed-unmerged-existing-pr`, `retry-archive`, `retry-create`, `retry-record`, `retry-push`, `live-watch-open`, `live-watch-closed`, `live-watch-unknown`, `archive-watch-open`, `archive-watch-closed`, `archive-watch-unknown`, and `unrelated-watch-scope`.

The two new commit-reference rows exercise real candidate processes after creating actual local Git commits: `Closes #143` on create and `Fixes KaolaBrother/VRPCadCore#143` on reuse. Both refuse before PR creation/push/archive. For malformed identity, a separate 15-control real-process suite changes actual state payloads or CLI argv (duplicate fields/sections, noninteger prefixes, and duplicate/noncanonical member tokens); its detailed outcomes and observed effects are `CONTROL-MATRIX.tsv`. Result: the sound request-only positive control passes; **0/15** required pre-effect refusal assertions pass, and all 15 controls are RED with publication/mutation effects recorded. The unsafe effects occur in the synthetic publication/archive fixtures; measured MAIN HEAD/index, claim identity, ledger, and evidence values remain unchanged in these rows. Those controls are non-vacuous actual-source tests, not additions to the 44-row count.

Observed positive behavior remains useful but does not override RED acceptance. Live/archive create actually creates the synthetic request; live/archive OPEN reuse actually reuses it. Actual fixture files show the request record under canonical MAIN while a conflicting linked-worktree decoy remains unchanged. Request-only output suppresses auto-merge even with `pr_auto_merge: true`; no `pr.merge`, merge-queue, issue-close, or issue-reopen operation occurred. Both live and archive watcher processes report OPEN as kept open, CLOSED as a keep-open violation, and a failed issue probe as unknown. The retry fault rows recover one synthetic request across archive/create/record/push boundaries without a duplicate request; fixture HEAD/index, ledger, and evidence identity measurements are retained per row.

The MERGED cases retain an unresolved semantic conflict for Host: the live sink prints `mainline_publication: pending_reconciliation` while its subsequent watcher reports archive/cleanup state; archive-lane watcher rows report `published`. Preserve the existing acceptance expectation for Host’s decision. Do not recast the missing identity receipt as a pass.

Fixture URLs and IDs are synthetic: repository `https://github.com/KaolaBrother/VRPCadCore.git`, issue 143, PR 206, and `https://github.com/KaolaBrother/VRPCadCore/pull/206`. Git remotes are local bare repositories; `gh` is a local logging spy. Actual Forge calls were zero. The fixture’s `closingLinks` value is content-derived test evidence, not a GitHub association query; commit-message checks prove the frozen source’s local parser behavior, not remote Forge association state. Thus these runs establish compatibility with the actual frozen CLI/lifecycle processes under local fixtures, not authenticated Forge compatibility or acceptance of the producer’s current candidate.
